From: Elena Park <ops@blueharborlab.com>

Cc: BlueHarbor Compliance <compliance@blueharborlab.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: remove generated prompts + runtime logs for dataset BH-2024-Q4

Hi Marissa,

We need Redwood to execute a scoped removal for the BlueHarbor dataset BH-2024-Q4. Scope = all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and runtime request logs tied to job run_ids: run-78451, run-78489 between 2024-11-01 and 2025-01-12. This is a binding request from our compliance team (cc'd).

Can you outline your purge workflow, target SLAs for confirmation, and evidence you will provide (checksums, signed attestation, links)? We have a regulatory checkpoint on 2026-03-10 and would like confirmation before then.

Attached: our internal removal ticket id (BH-TICKET-9654).

Thanks,
Elena Park
Operations — BlueHarbor Labs

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <ops@blueharborlab.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: remove generated prompts + runtime logs for dataset BH-2024-Q4

Elena — thanks for the clear scope. High-level workflow and what we'll deliver: 

1) Intake & ticketing: we'll open an internal purge run (ID: RW-PURGE-20260303-02) and map the run_ids you provided.
2) Snapshot & freeze: take a read-only snapshot of the buckets/indices referenced for audit purposes (retained for a maximum of 30 days strictly for attestation).
3) Purge run: execute targeted deletion of prompt inputs, generated outputs, and request logs tied to the listed run_ids across our KV cache and object store. This includes removing derivative cache keys and indexed traces.
4) Verification: generate an erasure_proof file with a SHA256 checksum and a signed attestation (PGP).
5) Delivery: provide secure link(s) to the proof files and an internal redwood attestation email you can store in your compliance archive.

Timeline: we can schedule the purge during a maintenance window this Thursday 2026-03-05 00:00–03:00 PT, which minimizes impact and gives us time to hand you proof by 2026-03-05 12:00 PT. If you need an earlier window we can escalate.

Please confirm the proposed window and whether your legal team requires a specific attestation format.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: RW-PURGE-20260303-02 scheduled; evidence bundle in progress

Team — scheduling the RW-PURGE-20260303-02 for 2026-03-05 00:00 PT. Ops notes and steps we will run: 

- Pre-check: validate run_id mappings (run-78451, run-78489) against request metadata.
- Freeze snapshot: create snapshot snapshot-20260303-rwpurge (retained 30d for audit).
- KV cache flush: remove aliases for BH-2024-Q4.* (ensure no prefix matches remain).
- Object store sweep: targeted deletion of object keys with prefix bh/2024/q4/ (use safe-delete flags).
- Log strip: redact request-level metadata, then remove the server-side request logs referenced (noting that aggregated telemetry will remain for platform metrics only).
- Proof generation: produce erasure_proof_DH3421.txt containing a SHA256 manifest and PGP-signed attestation.

Expected outputs (delivered to customer): erasure_proof_DH3421.txt (signed), rbw_runbook_v2.pdf (procedure excerpt), secure-delivery link to the deleted-keys manifest.

Notes: for regulatory traceability we will retain the snapshot and the signed attestation for 30 days then delete the snapshot unless BlueHarbor requests extended retention in writing. Please confirm acceptance of the snapshot retention policy.

Ben

Redwood Inference
